End is the WDGC: 'Ameriya' here is read as the Western Desert Gas Complex rather than the Amreya oil and gas plant 10.2 km away, because WDGC is the processing destination for Western Desert field gas — that anchor is GEM-internal (start of the applied P3934/P8032 routes), which is why it contributes no [ref]. 223 km chord vs 253 km sheet: a real 253 km route through the Western Desert corridor over a 223 km chord is exactly the expected excess, so length and corridor agree here. endpoints-only line: confirm both endpoint sources before applying.
